fields.summary: The district is adding $198,000 to its consultant agreement with Lowe Consulting Group, Inc. of Oakland and extending it one year, from June 30, 2021 to June 30, 2022. Lowe helps with Project Labor Agreement services, including local hiring, union representation, and monitoring of prevailing wages and local apprentices, for the bond-funded facilities program. The attached amendment sets the new total at $558,000; the agenda text misprints it as $588,000.

21-1052.note: Corrected: the new total is $558,000, as stated in the attached amendment, not the $588,000 printed in the agenda text.
21-1052.sourceIssue: The official text's numbers don't add up: $360,000 plus $198,000 is $558,000, but it states a new total of $588,000. The attached amendment states $558,000.
